name: ui-read-ahead-field-mapping
description: When a UI change needs an API field the generated client does not carry yet (denkhaus/work#1164 PR state), map it defensively in the data layer: cast the payload to {field?: unknown}, narrow to the known literal union in one helper, map to undefined otherwise. The UI activates the moment the server half ships the field, with zero further UI change and no hand-mirroring of the generated client.
